clips.title: The story
paras: Devlin's Remains are the collected skeletal bones of Devlin Agamand, the younger son of the wealthy family who owned the Agamand Mills. Stalking the roads near his ruined ancestral estate as a mindless Scourge thrall, he was struck down to deliver his bones to a vengeful survivor in Brill.

In life, Devlin Agamand stood in the shadow of his elder brother Thurman. Where Thurman was gentle and tall, Devlin was remembered as physically frail and viciously sharp-tongued. When the Plague of Undeath swept through northern Tirisfal Glades, the Agamand family failed to protect their lands and laborers. Devlin was among the first to fall, reanimated as a ravenous Scourge ghoul whose frantic, mad chattering haunted the roadside leading up to Agamand Mills.

Coleman Farthing, a Forsaken residing in Brill, holds a deep and abiding grudge against the entire Agamand bloodline. Holding them directly responsible for failing his family when the plague arrived, Farthing tasked travelers with laying Devlin to rest and collecting his remains. Farthing sought to display Devlin's bones upon his mantle, savoring the knowledge that his former masters have been reduced to dust and shattered fragments under his heel.
